name: morf-x
description: MORF-X: your tone, in motion. Morph a POD Go or Helix block between five tones over USB.

scripts.pack-mac: npm run web && electron-packager . MORF-X --platform=darwin --arch=arm64,x64 --out=dist --overwrite --icon=res/MORF-X.icns --app-bundle-id=uk.toneshift.morfx --ignore=^/dist --ignore=^/res/iconset && sh sign-mac.sh
